title: Irascibility
summary: IRASCIBIL'ITY IRAS'CIBLE, adjective [Latin irascor, from ira. See Ire.] Very susceptible of anger; easily provoked or inflamed with resentment; irritable; as an irascible man; an irascible temper.

inlines.v: IRASCIBIL'ITY IRAS'CIBLE, adjective [Latin irascor, from ira. See Ire.] Very susceptible of anger; easily provoked or inflamed with resentment; irritable; as an irascible man; an irascible temper.
